goal_checks.notes: blueprint canvasLeaves[marquee] (active, hasPainter: true) now has a real marquee.painter.ts; verify:arch I25 passes, and I17 scans the real tree with `batchDraw`/`new Konva` only inside the painter. marquee.painter.test.ts proves add/commit/clear/dispose; use-marquee.test.ts proves the painter is created on the first stroke and disposed on unmount. The freehand-lasso tool and the rectangle tool share the one leaf (analyze.json NEW-1: the blueprint lists no second region leaf).

Pointer Events only: use-marquee.ts reads e.evt.pointerType; stylus.ts turns the first `pen` of the session into palm rejection (touch ignored) while the documented Q9 default keeps a finger working before any pen. While armed the leaf swallows the pointer (stopPropagation + preventDefault) so page-stage's pan/zoom cannot fight the stroke, and it is not listening at all when disarmed. PageStage's touch-action is now `none` only while `drawing`, else `touch-pan-x touch-pan-y` (03 §7), pinned by page-stage.test.tsx. The acceptance criterion ('scrolling works whenever no draw tool is active') is met structurally: a disarmed, fixture-free Marquee renders nothing and captures nothing. Q8/Q9 still need a human on real hardware — that is the task Gate, not this criterion.

shared/lib/ocr.ts imports tesseract.js lazily (`await import` inside getWorker), runs it in Tesseract's own Worker, and crops before recognize: cropRegion draws only the crop rect into an offscreen canvas and recognizeRegion is handed that crop. There is no whole-page path — the function's only geometry input is one crop Rect. ocr.test.ts proves the crop dimensions/draw args, the single reused worker, and fail-soft behaviour. RULE-19 (OCR last rung, crops only) holds.

OCR_CONFIDENCE_GATE = 0.70; needsCorrection()/isResultEligible() make a below-gate (or null-confidence) OCR highlight needs-correction and excluded from Result input. confidence-gate.test.ts pins 0.69 excluded / 0.70 included / text-layer always eligible; use-region-highlight-capture.test.ts proves a 0.4 mark still writes (the gate is a derived filter, not a store-time rejection), which is what lets a human still see and accept the mark. The Result engine (020) consumes isResultEligible().

marquee.stories.tsx provides Default, Empty, ManyStrokes (220 points, over the plan's >=200) and DarkTheme; the stories project ran all four in real headless Chrome (4/4) as part of npm run verify. Konva cannot inherit CSS variables, so the DarkTheme story hands an explicit resolved colour — the same handoff 04 §10 requires.

cross_check_against_plan.result: matches — frontend, depends on 009 (done); the five mini-goals map one-to-one to g1-g5; it blocks 021 and does not open it.

matches — region capture stores extraction='ocr' with normalized page-relative rects (RULE-17); OCR runs cropped and last-rung (RULE-19); handwriting is not rasterized for Tesseract (ink-only paths stay out, 024).

matches — imperative Konva lives only in the painter (I17), coordinates leave normalized (I19), the live stroke stays in a ref; Pointer Events with pointerType==='pen' palm rejection and touch-action toggled only while a draw tool is active.

matches — the marquee leaf has the required painter, types, tests and stories; fixtures live in __mocks__; the stories include the mandated ManyStrokes and DarkTheme. §11 hazard #3 (batchDraw in a .tsx) and #5 (viewport pixels stored) are both avoided.

matches — one bbox Json column carries {page, rects, color, tool}; extraction is text_layer|ocr; confidence holds the raw value and the 0.70 gate is applied as a derived predicate, so no column was invented.
matches — I17/I18 green, I19 respected (normalize before leaving the painter/hook), I20 (no motion import) untouched, I25 satisfied by the new painter.

issues_found: Q8/Q9 remain unanswered: the task's own Gate — a scanned page yields a usable highlight and ink stays at 60 fps with 200 points on the pilot tablet — is a human on-device measurement, deferred as a follow-up exactly as 009's 60 fps gate check was. Nothing in g1-g5 depends on it.

The plan's g1 wording says 'marquee + freehand ink leaves' (plural), but architecture.blueprint.json lists exactly one active region leaf, `marquee` (04 §5.2 agrees). Both tools were placed in the one leaf rather than inventing a leaf the blueprint does not carry (analyze.json NEW-1); if a separate freehand leaf was intended, the blueprint must gain it first.

This task overrides task 009's global `touch-none` on PageStage with 03 §7's conditional touch-action; that is a deliberate correction (009's choice is the 'scrolling dies' case the spec names), recorded here so it is not reverted by accident.
Tesseract downloads its worker script and traineddata on first use; a truly offline first OCR needs those assets bundled (a deployment change), meanwhile the seam fails soft to a below-gate mark.
The 0.70 gate currently has no UI affordance to accept/correct a needs-correction mark — the predicate exists, the human review screen does not (021/013 territory).
No route arms a region tool yet: RegionHighlightCapture takes `tool` as a prop but no container sets it, the same route-wiring gap 009/010/012 recorded.
